comments.body:
Sorry for the oversight, I'm working on adding a test.

Migrating was mentioned as a [GSoC idea](https://github.com/NixOS/GSoC/blob/main/ideas/2026.md?plain=1#L45), so I attempted this as a proof of concept. Maybe I should make it a draft instead?

> It would be news to me that we actually **migrate** things already?

The goal of the GSoC project is to develop these modules under supervision without any significant user-facing migration for the time being.

I'll have to review this PR more carefully to see whether user-facing changes are required, but if so, I concur that'd be premature until a (new) RFC is approved.
This could be very useful for nix-darwin and home-manager to abstract away some of the surfaces

> This could be very useful for nix-darwin and home-manager to abstract away some of the surfaces

That would still be an abstraction with major behavioral differences given all the additional stuff that's being implemented for the systemd service and missing on other service managers.

issue.body:
An attempt to migrate [`services.kanata`](https://github.com/jtroo/kanata) into a modular service. I'm still learning how to do modular services, hope someone can review and let me know if anything needs fixing.

There's also `services.arsenik` that depends on `services.kanata`, so I temporarily changed it to import the new `kanata.services.default` instead. Todo: Migrate `services.arsenik` into a modular service.
